newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France starts Paris-Jakarta B747 cargo service.
newsitem.headline: Air France starts Paris-Jakarta B747 cargo service.

text.p: Air France said it has this month launched a weekly Boeing 747-200 freighter service between Paris and the Indonesian capital, Jakarta, via Kuala Lumpur.

"This is the first time we have served Jakarta with full-freighter aircraft. Along with Malaysia, Indonesia is an emerging market for air cargo and these are two countries where we are looking to develop our presence," an Air France cargo official told Reuters.
Malaysian carrier MAS has a 30-tonne block booking on the Air France 747-200F service to Jakarta, which leaves Paris-CDG on Tuesdays, a MAS official said.
Air France currently operates a five times weekly Airbus 340 passenger service from Paris to Jakarta
It also makes a weekly 747-200F full-freighter stopover at Kuala Lumpur en route to Singapore on a flight operated in conjunction with Singapore Airlines.
